name: Suzurikawa Euphrasie Ruika
original_name: 硯川・ユーフラジー・涙香
source:
Class: 3-B

The student council president who is always taking care of the whole student body and has an older sister-like personality. She loves having fun, and has a lot of charisma to match her personality. Despite missing some things, she has made them up with her hard work and wit. She is rumored to be a flashy lover, but in fact, spends her free time watching the animals in nearby lakes and even playing with them.
